newsitem.title: USA: US Plains cattle trade nil,showlists sold-feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains cattle trade nil,showlists sold-feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets were inactive early Friday following this week's sales which depleted most showlists, feedlot sources said.
"Attitudes are much better, with most feedlots current and the thinking is that the worst is over," Texas Panhandle-area feedlot manager said.

Fed cattle this week sold at $63.00 sliding beef prices and plentiful supplies of market-ready cattle. At $63.00, many cattle owners lost $10.00 to $35.00 per head. However, outlooks for improved demand next week has owners pricing cattle at $65.00, they said.
